reasoning_content: Now the shims should exist. But awscli mise-bins and 1password-cli now use github? Wait, mise.toml says `1password-cli = "2.38.1"`. Anyway, now `mise which op` works and points to install path. Let me reshim and verify.

action.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace && FILTER='vfox|stack|require|C\]:|crates|no field|no file|can.t load'; mise reshim 2>&1 | grep -viE "$FILTER" | tail -2; for t in op aws; do printf "%s shim: " "$t"; ls ~/.local/share/mise/shims/$t 2>/dev/null && echo OK || echo MISSING; done; echo "--- versions ---"; mise exec -- op --version 2>&1 | grep -viE "$FILTER" | tail -1; mise exec -- aws --version 2>&1 | grep -viE "$FILTER" | tail -1

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "export PATH=\"$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH\"; cd /workspace && FILTER='vfox|stack|require|C\\]:|crates|no field|no file|can.t load'; mise reshim 2>&1 | grep -viE \"$FILTER\" | tail -2; for t in op aws; do printf \"%s shim: \" \"$t\"; ls ~/.local/share/mise/shims/$t 2>/dev/null && echo OK || echo MISSING; done; echo \"--- versions ---\"; mise exec -- op --version 2>&1 | grep -viE \"$FILTER\" | tail -1; mise exec -- aws --version 2>&1 | grep -viE \"$FILTER\" | tail -1", "summary": "Reshim and verify op/aws"}
